Private Function Where(ByVal sh As Object) As String
    Where = sh.Left & "," & sh.Top & "," & sh.Width & "," & sh.Height & "," & sh.TopLeftCell.Address(0, 0) & "," & sh.BottomRightCell.Address(0, 0)
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, sh As Shape, co As ChartObject
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set sh = ws.Shapes.AddShape(msoShapeRectangle, 110, 20, 120, 40)
    Set co = ws.ChartObjects.Add(70, 50, 150, 60)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize: co.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
    Case 1
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize: co.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Columns("A:B").ColumnWidth = 20
    Case 2
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize: co.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Columns("C").ColumnWidth = 30
    Case 3
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize: co.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Columns("E").ColumnWidth = 30
    Case 4
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize: co.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Columns("C").ColumnWidth = 2
    Case 5
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize: co.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Columns("C").ColumnWidth = 0
    Case 6
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize: co.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Columns("A:Z").ColumnWidth = 3
    Case 7
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize: co.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Rows("1:2").RowHeight = 40
    Case 8
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize: co.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Rows("3").RowHeight = 50
    Case 9
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize: co.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Rows("2").RowHeight = 3
    Case 10
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize: co.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Columns("B").Hidden = True
    Case 11
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize: co.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Rows("2").Hidden = True
    Case 12
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize: co.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.Columns("C").AutoFit
    Case 13
        sh.Placement = xlMoveAndSize: co.Placement = xlMoveAndSize
        ws.StandardWidth = 12
    Case 14
        sh.Placement = xlMove: co.Placement = xlMove
    Case 15
        sh.Placement = xlMove: co.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Columns("A:B").ColumnWidth = 20
    Case 16
        sh.Placement = xlMove: co.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Columns("C").ColumnWidth = 30
    Case 17
        sh.Placement = xlMove: co.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Columns("E").ColumnWidth = 30
    Case 18
        sh.Placement = xlMove: co.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Columns("C").ColumnWidth = 2
    Case 19
        sh.Placement = xlMove: co.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Columns("C").ColumnWidth = 0
    Case 20
        sh.Placement = xlMove: co.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Columns("A:Z").ColumnWidth = 3
    Case 21
        sh.Placement = xlMove: co.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Rows("1:2").RowHeight = 40
    Case 22
        sh.Placement = xlMove: co.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Rows("3").RowHeight = 50
    Case 23
        sh.Placement = xlMove: co.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Rows("2").RowHeight = 3
    Case 24
        sh.Placement = xlMove: co.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Columns("B").Hidden = True
    Case 25
        sh.Placement = xlMove: co.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Rows("2").Hidden = True
    Case 26
        sh.Placement = xlMove: co.Placement = xlMove
        ws.Columns("C").AutoFit
    Case 27
        sh.Placement = xlMove: co.Placement = xlMove
        ws.StandardWidth = 12
    Case 28
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating: co.Placement = xlFreeFloating
    Case 29
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating: co.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Columns("A:B").ColumnWidth = 20
    Case 30
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating: co.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Columns("C").ColumnWidth = 30
    Case 31
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating: co.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Columns("E").ColumnWidth = 30
    Case 32
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating: co.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Columns("C").ColumnWidth = 2
    Case 33
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating: co.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Columns("C").ColumnWidth = 0
    Case 34
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating: co.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Columns("A:Z").ColumnWidth = 3
    Case 35
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating: co.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Rows("1:2").RowHeight = 40
    Case 36
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating: co.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Rows("3").RowHeight = 50
    Case 37
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating: co.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Rows("2").RowHeight = 3
    Case 38
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating: co.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Columns("B").Hidden = True
    Case 39
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating: co.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Rows("2").Hidden = True
    Case 40
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating: co.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.Columns("C").AutoFit
    Case 41
        sh.Placement = xlFreeFloating: co.Placement = xlFreeFloating
        ws.StandardWidth = 12
    End Select
    Tried = "ok " & Where(sh) & "|" & Where(co)
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    For i = 0 To 41
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
